resources.string: Find your way around Toolbox, then explore a tool family at your own pace. You can close the guide at any time.
Eight stops through Home, Tools, image creation, Library, Tama and Settings.
Tap the highlighted control. You are using the real app.
This control is not visible here. You can open the tool, view the example, retry, or skip this step.
Example from the app with demonstration data. Your models, projects and results may be different.
Explore freely: no model download, permission, purchase or running task is required to finish this guide.
Pin: keep a tool handy on Home.
Gear: configure the app or tool.
Three dots: more actions and options.
Arrow: return to the previous page.
Stop: cancel running work; check its status before retrying.

Home keeps pinned tools, recent conversations and projects close by. Status cards show what is available on this device. Use the four main destinations to move around; on compact screens or with larger text, open the menu instead.

Open Tools using the highlighted navigation control. Search by task or engine name, or browse the categories. The pin keeps a tool on Home; the small gear opens its settings. Next, we will open image generation.

Open Image generation. Describe an image in the prompt, choose a compatible model, and review the readiness message. Advanced controls expand when needed. Generate starts work, Stop cancels it, and Gallery contains saved results. You can continue this tour without installing a model or generating anything.
Tap the top-left arrow to return to Tools. Deep tools have their own Back control; the main navigation returns when you reach a root page. Your saved results remain available from Library.

Open Library. Models lets you download or import compatible assets. Knowledge stores searchable documents, and Offline content opens your reading collection. The output links take you directly to image, video and audio galleries. Empty collections explain how to get started.

Open Tama to see your pet room or the first-pet setup. Care actions sit below the full room; scroll or swipe to find more. Inventory, shop, farm, games and adventures have their own entrances. This guide does not create a pet, spend coins, or change your room.

Tap the gear. General settings contains appearance and language. Other groups configure models, generation, speech and diagnostics. About includes help and support links. Use Back when you are ready to return to the main navigation.

Return to Home. The Explore button beside Settings opens this guide again. Resume an unfinished chapter, replay the essentials, or choose a tool family. The X always closes guidance and leaves you in the app.
No pet is available yet. Open Tama to check or set up your companion. Your farm, games and gallery will become available when a pet is ready.
